source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Repeat link up and down in OS.
2. Check network function by pinging port's IP.
3. Repeat step 1~2 for 5 times per port.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. NIC should work when it link up and not work when it link down.
2. NIC should still be normal after link flap for 5 times.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Software down, blind 2-second delay, up and filtered ethtool output.
deepseek_columns.risk: BMC-port outage can drop management connectivity.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; recognizes OOB risk but does not show external down-state ping, stable MAC identity or state-based recovery.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds exact interface/MAC, independent observer, OOB, per-cycle down/up evidence and recovery timeout.

original_test_intent: For each approved OS-visible BMC/shared-management port, perform five link-down/link-up cycles, prove reachability is absent while down and restored while up, and confirm final NIC/BMC operation is normal.
original_method: A controller running over an independent path binds the target by MAC/PCI identity, toggles only that interface, uses an external observer to ping the port IP in each state, monitors carrier/speed and logs, and repeats exactly five cycles with bounded recovery gates.
manual_activity: One authorized user approves the target and interruption plan. No physical operation or human visual acceptance is required; link control, external ping, state monitoring and evidence collection can all be automated over independent control paths.
required_inputs: Interface/MAC/PCI identity and confirmation it represents the intended BMC/shared port
Port IP and independent observer address/path
Exactly five cycles, down/up dwell or state timeouts and expected negotiated speed
Confirmation no unrelated production traffic depends on the interface
Working OOB recovery method and approved restoration command
safety_requirements: Never control the test through the link being dropped; verify independent OOB and observer first.
Bind by MAC/hardware identity, not an assumed interface name.
Confirm external ping loss while down and recovery while up; local carrier alone is insufficient.
Use state transitions/timeouts rather than blind `sleep 2`; stop on wrong target or failed recovery.
No automatic retry, reboot, BMC reconfiguration or extra cycle after failure.
agent_execution_scope: Validate identity, traffic isolation, OOB and observer reachability.
Execute five approved down/up cycles with per-state carrier, speed, address and external ping evidence.
Collect OS network events and BMC/SEL deltas and verify final configuration/reachability.
Report Tool Result separately from engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the identified interface, five-cycle outage plan and recovery path.
Resolve whether a non-OS-visible dedicated BMC port requires a different authorized method.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete and quoting-sensitive: it uses a fixed delay, omits external ping during both states, may lose its own SSH path and only filters post-up ethtool output.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a reviewed local/OOB cycle runner with stable MAC resolution, independent ping timestamps and state-based carrier/reachability timeouts for exactly five cycles.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OS link transitions, ping check, five cycles per port and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Coordinate OS-side link control and an external ping observer through an OOB supervisor, producing a per-cycle transition table and final health snapshot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: OS-visible BMC/shared NIC with independent OOB/control path.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record OS/kernel, NIC driver/firmware, iproute2, ethtool and BMC firmware.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform BMC/shared-port architecture and OS NIC administration documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces blind timing and self-observation with deterministic external state evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; strengthens down and recovery proof.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Stable interface mapping and independent observer.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A dedicated BMC-only NIC not exposed to the host OS cannot use the stated OS method and needs owner clarification.

project_override_considerations: A project may define timing and interface set, but completion must still include five cycles for every approved port and may claim only the approved plan.
expected_evidence: Five per-cycle down/up timestamps with carrier and external ping loss/recovery
OS network events, BMC/SEL and any watchdog/recovery action
Final configuration/speed/reachability, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The OS link-flap and ping criteria are coherent if the BMC/shared port is host-visible. Exact architecture is a readiness input; the source does not explicitly assert a dedicated non-host interface.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The test has clear semantics and is executable after interface/OOB/observer mapping. Those inputs do not make it permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains software link control but adds the missing independent down/up reachability proof and removes blind timing.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains all identity/OOB safeguards but corrects the class: approval and recovery readiness do not make an automated workflow partial.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates automation class, execution status, Tool Result and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Makes each of the five flap states externally observable and prevents loss of the control channel from being mistaken for a completed test.
independent_technical_reasoning: All core state changes and acceptance signals are machine-operable. High availability risk requires independent OOB and approval, not human execution, so FULLY AUTOMATABLE is correct.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat a failed cycle, add cycles, reboot or change BMC/network configuration automatically. Preserve state and use only the approved recovery action.
